aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Mother Lakṣmī;
Mother, victory to you, Mother Lakṣmī!
Śiva, Viṣṇu and Brahmā serve you night and day.
aarti.pad1: You are Umā, Ramā and Brahmāṇī;
you alone are the Mother of the world.
The Sun and the Moon meditate on you,
and the sage Nārada sings your praise.
aarti.pad2: You are Durgā in form, the stainless one,
the giver of happiness and wealth.
aarti.pad3: you alone give what is good.
You bring to light the effects of deeds,
and you are the protector from the ocean of worldly existence.
aarti.pad4: In the house where you dwell,
and the heart is not troubled.
aarti.pad5: Without you no sacrifices are performed,
All the splendour of food and drink
aarti.pad6: You are the beautiful temple of auspicious virtues,
born of the ocean of milk.
no one gains the fourteen jewels.
aarti.pad7: Whoever sings the āratī of Mahālakṣmī
finds his heart filled with joy,
